findings.reason: as written a dispatcher reads s13 as unbuilt while s14 asserts it landed, so it either schedules §13 over code that has since merged (6dcb6cc1d) or dispatches §14 against a helper it cannot find; the two must be reconciled by advancing s13's declaration if §13 has landed, else by making s14's premise conditional.
findings.text: s14's Why opens "§13 landed `_review_record_directory_grant` in `reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py`" and its deliverable and done-when treat §13's output as already present ("the parts-count rule in `_review_record_directory_grant` is removed", "the file's existing cases still pass" in `tests/test_a_run_review_with_run_directory_records_dispatches.py`), but the plan declares s13 `implementable` (line 26) and at the reviewed revision the helper and that test file are both absent and §13's code commit f912c7ec5 is not an ancestor (gate-anchors.log) — so s14's prose and the plan's declaration disagree inside the same commit

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `review.run_review_record_location`, `_resolved_reviewed_run_id`, `_delivered_record_location`, `_declared_write_grant` and `fenced_write_roots` all resolve, and the cited review run r-20261017T040235877031 exists with reuse 8; `_review_record_directory_grant` is §13's own symbol, carried by the reasoning finding below.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — s14's done-when is measurable (a run-A record path admitted, a run-B path refused `scoped`) and names a negative control (restore the any-run grant; the run-B case must fail).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the negative-control log is declared under the run directory, a durable path, not a scratchpad or node-local temporary.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, ticket numbers or version tags reach the new symbols or the test filename; §12/§13 are in-document section cross-references, the plan's convention.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — s14's Why asserts "§13 landed `_review_record_directory_grant`", a state its own plan declaration denies and the reviewed tree does not hold.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — s14 carries one deliverable, confining a review node's record-path grant to the run its node id reviews.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — s14's dependency on s13 is carried by the open followup f-awcwyh-015 ("Build it after §13 merges, because both write `dispatch_admission.py` and the same test file"); no relationship points at the wrong node.
